# segyio 1.9.14

The unmodified wheel is dynamically imported by Python. Its original wheel hash
is in 00_manifest/dependency_inventory.json. License.md is the upstream LGPL-3
text and COPYING is GPL-3. Complete upstream v1.9.14 source is in the accompanying
tar.gz; provenance records its URL and SHA256. Build instructions are in that
source's README and CMake files. Upstream: https://github.com/equinor/segyio/tree/v1.9.14

The toolkit's Apache-2.0 license does not relicense this dependency. You may use
the source distribution to build/modify the library under its own license.
Managed standalone runtime repair restores package-pinned files. For development,
use the public toolkit source with your chosen Python environment/library build;
the source engine can be run directly without the standalone cache repair step.
